set.body: Move image4s geometry, core, NIfTI, reference, laws, and locus bridge into github.com/canardlapin/image4s. Eliminate the reframe4s/image4s release cycle by transferring geometry ownership to image4s, preserve the one-Ravel-storage contract, publish an immutable commit, update reframe4s and ScalaFIM consumers, and require JVM/Scala.js plus allocation/performance evidence before closing.
set.title: Extract image4s to an independent immutable repository
